violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: Raw chicken and raw meat observed stored above vegetables, inside the walk-in refrigerator
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION .

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: Soups, sauces and other foods prepared on site, and held over 24 hours, were not date marked, as required.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC (4 Hour), Initial Temp of 41F or 135F
violations.observation: Observed that the time when the initial temperature of the sushi rice was135F or above, was placed out of temperature control, was not written or provided or posted .
violations.corrective_action: The time sushi rice preparation was completed and taken out of temperature control, must be provided or written on the container that’s is holding the rice. The rice should not be held for more than 4 hours. It must be discarded end after 4 hours. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. Spray bottles containing toxic cleaning chemicals, are to be properly labeled, to identify contents, preventing unintentional use and exposure.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials.CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION. MARUMEN (Inspection Date: 01/21/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: Salt, sugar, msg, soy sauce, and avariety of pastes and sauces.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Oven baked chicken breast=125F at steam well.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. Corrected during the inspection (REHEATED)

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Raw calamari=61F, kimchi=59F, Sliced Sausage hotdog mix=54Fm, shell eggs=61F, spice paste=62F, cut fried chicken = 72F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. These foods were discarded during the inspection . This violation has b even previously cited. Make permanent corrections.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: Sushi rice.. The sushi rice was not observed labeled to show end time for the rice to be discarded to ensure that it is not held over 4.0 hours.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. MARUMEN (Inspection Date: 07/10/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. Wet wiping towels were found on work tables and not in sanitizing solutions as required.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: Knives were observed stored in-between tables and between tables and refrigeration units. Also, a large ice scoop was found stored directly on top of the ice machine.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION. (The knives were relocated.) Place the ice scoop on a scoop dispenser or in a cleaned and sanitized surface or in the ice bucket, after each use to protect it from being contaminated. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.
